title: check's merge hint fires only on a merge-shaped stale render
findings_note: s325 relay 2026-10-17, reviewer finding 1: the roadmap-only hint also prints when the roadmap render is stale with cause `missing`, or `renderer_format` in a project with no slice renders
boundary: **Not in this slice:** the hint text, or `stale_render_kind` values.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: s325's hint says the stale roadmap render is "as a merge leaves it". It also prints for a missing render file or an old render format, which are not merges, although `slicer render` is still the fix. The owner decides whether the hint should require every stale cause to be `content`.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Owner decision 2026-10-17: the hint prints only when every stale cause is `content`.
2. Write the tests; watch them go red.
3. Require every `stale_render_details` cause to be `content` in `merge_shape`; CHANGELOG; mutation-check.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: - `python3.12 tests/affected.py --run`, then the full suite. `slicer check` passes.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: One commit on the slice branch; the owner lands it.
